limitations: No normal-home artifact installation, artifact execution, GUI/menu/dock validation or real user-manager query/mutation was performed.
Native installer tests use disposable private roots as a non-root user. Component tests use container isolation, fake managers and captured foreground fixtures, not deployed-host lifecycle evidence.
Dagger used engine/cache and exported development artifacts; these results are not clean-cache, offline, hermetic-build, clean-host or release-provenance evidence.
The manifest covers focused installer/Make/Dagger/policy/documentation inputs, not every Rust/Flutter dependency or a complete distributable source/artifact manifest.

Multiple publications are not a global transaction. Exchange conflicts can leave current changed; displaced objects and stages are retained, cleanup separately scoped, and no rollback or arbitrary same-UID filesystem CAS protection is claimed.

Owner-controlled digests detect stale mixing and accidental changes, not adversarial rewriting. Consequential deployment/release approval must independently retain the evidence digest and bind exact artifacts and effects.
Only this evidence file was authorized for reviewer source-tree writing. No commit, remote mutation, deployment, host integration or accepted-risk approval is granted.
